notes.modes: Votes split by mode; early and mail are never pooled with election day, because they break in opposite directions. Georgia names them Advance Voting and Absentee by Mail.
notes.left: early_and_mail_left is measured - ballots recorded cast early or by mail in that county, minus those modes as counted here.
notes.election_day: Ballots still to come on election day are not estimated; only precincts not yet reporting are shown.
notes.source_change: Georgia left Clarity: the legacy host 403s on every detail path and its election list stops at June 2024. This reads the SOS results API the live site itself uses.
